tasks.title: Fade margin
tasks.solution: Margin ≈ (RSSI − noise) / 2 dB: one SiK RSSI unit ≈ 0.5 dB.

tasks.title: Margin and range
tasks.solution: Usable margin is m − k; range × 2^((m − k)/6).
